mapper.sql: SELECT q.*, u.nickname AS create_by_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scm_inquiry_item i WHERE i.inquiry_id = q.id) AS item_count, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.supplier_id) FROM scm_inquiry_quote p WHERE p.inquiry_id = q.id) AS supplier_count FROM scm_inquiry q LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = q.create_by
mapper.select: SELECT i.*, m.code AS material_code, m.name AS material_name, m.spec, m.unit, o.order_no FROM scm_inquiry_item i JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = i.material_id LEFT JOIN scm_order o ON o.id = i.order_id WHERE i.inquiry_id = #{inquiryId} ORDER BY i.id
SELECT p.*, s.name AS supplier_name, s.level AS supplier_level FROM scm_inquiry_quote p JOIN scm_supplier s ON s.id = p.supplier_id WHERE p.inquiry_id = #{inquiryId} ORDER BY p.supplier_id, p.item_id
